name: rudra-infotech-lab
description: Rudra InfoTech Lab — studio website + admin panel. Static TypeScript build (GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Lenis vendored), Supabase-backed CMS/CRM, Vercel functions.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json && node .build/scripts/build.js
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json --noEmit
